spec.title: Add parallel agents to festina-finalize for docs phase
spec.context:
The festina-finalize skill currently handles checks, product docs, engineering docs, and git operations all in a single context. Phase 2 (Documentation) executes product and engineering doc updates sequentially, leading to high cognitive load for the LLM, slower execution, and higher risk of errors in complex tasks.
The goal is to refactor Phase 2 to spawn parallel agents for product and engineering documentation updates, following the proven pattern already established in festina-scope (which uses 4 parallel agents for Deep research mode).

in-scope.item: Add Task tool to festina-finalize allowed-tools
Refactor Phase 2 to spawn Product Docs Agent and Engineering Docs Agent in parallel
Implement orchestrator logic to validate agent outputs before writing files
Implement single atomic commit after both agents complete
Handle conditional spawning (only spawn agents when needed)
Implement error handling when one or both agents fail

out-of-scope.item: Changes to Phase 1 (checks) - remains sequential with user interaction
Changes to docs-product.md or docs-engineering.md reference files
Changes to validation scripts or other supporting infrastructure

requirements.requirement: Given a task with both affects and engineering fields, when running /festina-finalize, then Phase 2 spawns Product Docs Agent AND Engineering Docs Agent in parallel using Task tool invocations in a single message.
Given a task with only affects (no engineering), when running /festina-finalize, then only Product Docs Agent is spawned (no unnecessary parallelism).
Given a task with only engineering (no affects), when running /festina-finalize, then only Engineering Docs Agent is spawned.
Given Phase 2 agents complete successfully, when orchestrator receives their results, then it validates all outputs before writing any files to disk.
Given validation passes, when orchestrator writes files, then it commits all doc changes in a single atomic commit with format "docs({id}): {type} - {description}".
Given an agent encounters an error, when it cannot complete its work, then it returns structured error details to orchestrator for user decision.
Given agent error, when orchestrator receives error, then it asks user whether to retry, skip that agent's docs, or abort Phase 2.
Agents must return structured summary output (file paths changed, validation status, summary) rather than full file diffs to reduce context overhead.
Orchestrator pre-loads smart context once before spawning agents, passing relevant context to each agent's prompt.
Orchestrator pre-fetches current doc content for docs being modified, passing to agents so they can make focused updates.
Glossary.yaml and _index.md updates are handled by orchestrator after agents complete, not by agents themselves.
Single user checkpoint before spawning agents showing analysis of both product AND engineering doc needs.

files.file: Main skill file. Add Task to allowed-tools (line 4). Refactor Phase 2 (lines 297-380) to use parallel agents.

patterns.pattern: Use Task tool to spawn agents in parallel. Invoke Task tool multiple times in a SINGLE message to achieve parallelism. Pattern from festina-scope lines 155-270. Reference: apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-scope/SKILL.md:155
Use <parallel> block containing <agent> elements with name, description, and prompt. Each agent has subagent_type="Explore". Reference: apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-scope/SKILL.md:158
Use when="condition" attribute on agents for conditional spawning based on needsProductDocs/needsEngineeringDocs flags. Reference: apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-explore/SKILL.md:119

Agent prompts must be self-contained with: job description, full task context (id, title, affects/engineering fields, acceptance criteria), specific steps to perform, and exact output format. Reference: apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-scope/SKILL.md:161-181

After parallel agents complete, synthesize results: combine outputs, deduplicate findings, resolve conflicts, prepare for commit. Reference: apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-scope/SKILL.md:276-287

product.finding: Main orchestrator skill with three sequential phases. Phase 2 is modularized but executed serially. Must maintain three phases, support resumption via git log.
Demonstrates structured research pattern with parallel exploration, then synthesis. Precedent for parallel agent execution.
Proven pattern for decomposing monolithic orchestrators. Orchestrators max ~300 lines; don't import each other.
Complete independent workflow for product docs. Fully independent from engineering docs.
Complete independent workflow for engineering docs. Fully independent from product docs.

engineering.finding: Split Phase 2 into domain-specific agents. Reference: .festinalente/engineering/patterns/orchestrator.md
Use Task tool to spawn agents simultaneously. Reference: festina-scope SKILL.md:155-270
Return {success/error} discriminated unions from agents. Reference: .festinalente/engineering/patterns/tagged-union-errors.md

pitfall.mitigation: Orchestrator writes all files atomically. Agents return file changes as output, not write files directly.
Agents return results (not write files). Orchestrator validates ALL outputs before writing anything. On error, ask user.
Agents return structured summary (file paths, validation errors), not full file diffs. Orchestrator reads files from disk if needed.
Single checkpoint before spawning agents. Show analysis for both product AND engineering together, then spawn if approved.
Agents don't write files. Orchestrator writes and commits all changes atomically in single critical section.
Each agent prompt must include full task context explicitly since agents don't inherit conversation history.
Orchestrator handles glossary.yaml and _index.md updates after agents complete, not agents.
Orchestrator pre-fetches current doc content and passes to agents in prompts.
Orchestrator pre-loads smart context once before spawning agents.
Orchestrator validates once after all agent changes are received, before writing files.

constraints.constraint: Phase 1 (checks) must remain sequential with user interaction for QA confirmation
Must maintain git resumption capability via git log detection
Agents cannot access conversation history - all context must be in prompt
Product and engineering docs touch different directories but share glossary.yaml
Commit message format must match workflow.yaml: "docs({id}): {type} - {description}"

dependencies.dependency: festina-scope parallel agent pattern (lines 154-273) - proven implementation to follow
docs-product.md and docs-engineering.md - reference content to embed in agent prompts
select-context.cjs - smart context loading script used by orchestrator
check-product.cjs and check-engineering.cjs - categorization scripts used in analyze_doc_impact

risk.mitigation: Orchestrator validates all outputs before writing. Asks user on any agent failure.

risks.risk: One agent may fail while the other succeeds, creating need for user decision on how to proceed.

risk.mitigation: Agents return structured summary, not full diffs. Orchestrator reads files from disk if detailed validation needed.

risks.risk: Context overhead from verbose agent outputs could impact orchestrator effectiveness.

risk.mitigation: Agent prompts embed docs-product.md and docs-engineering.md reference content, plus current doc state.

risks.risk: Agents may miss nuances without full context of current doc state and reference guidance.
